items.text: Says 7 p.m. Wakes up at 7 p.m.
Loudest in the group chat, ghost in DMs
Gym member for a year. Went twice.
Salary gone before payday
"I didn't study at all." Scores 100. Every time.
"Downstairs!" (Still at home.)
The whole group waits. Every time.
Ten photos before the first bite
Orders the whole menu, "to share"
Planning dinner during lunch
Vanishes every holiday. Sleep mode: on
Big plans. Zero follow-through
Sends emails at 2 a.m.
Took a work call at their own birthday
Gets a partner, drops off the map
Mention their partner? Clear your evening
One sentence, whole room offended
Roasts you, then asks "what did I say?"
Leaves you on read, watches your story instantly
Borrows things. Returns nothing.
